//: 8.0.0 was not a valid SDK version: feature bands start at 1, so 8.0.100 is
the lowest real 8.0 SDK. dotnet reported the file as Invalid and ignored it,
and the build silently used whatever was installed — 10.0.110 here.
rollForward latestMajor would have defeated the pinning even once the
version was legal, since it accepts any newer major.
10.0.100 is the band actually installed on the development machine. The
projects target net8.0 and a 10 SDK builds that; if an 8.0 SDK is wanted
instead, 8.0.100 with the same roll-forward is the equivalent line.
